3D Memory Crystal™ - Tabletop - Rectangle - Pet Lovers-Standard / Small

The 3D Memory Crystal™ Rectangle - Pet Lovers Edition turns a favorite photo of your dog, cat, or companion animal into a keepsake engraved inside K9 optical crystal. The same Beyond Memories® rectangle shape that handles family portraits, tuned for the close-up frame that pet photos almost always need. The image sits in three dimensions inside the crystal - nothing fades, peels, or scratches, even years after your pet is gone. Every pet crystal starts with your image. Our design team in Las Vegas reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity - brightening eyes, sharpening fur detail, softening a busy background. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. A 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building your pet's photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packed in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms. 100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - sharp enough to capture fur, whiskers, and eye highlights Expert photo enhancement included - phone photos in natural light usually work Available in seven sizes: Mini, Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max, Premium Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout Compatible with the Memory Light Base™ (sold separately) for illuminated display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included How the personalization works The pet portrait engraving is built inside the crystal, not on its surface. After you upload a photo at checkout, our design team reviews it specifically for pet-photo challenges - dark fur on a dark background, motion blur, bright eye flash. Our artists adjust contrast and clarity, then convert your image into a 3D engraving model. The 4K laser fires microscopic refractive points at exact depths inside the K9 glass, forming your pet's portrait with lifelike volume. Compatible with the Memory Light Base for illuminated tabletop display. What photo works best A close-up photo of your pet's face or head-and-shoulders frame engraves with the sharpest detail. Bright natural light (a window or outdoor shot) brings out fur texture and eye highlights better than indoor lamps. The rectangle shape favors vertical orientation - a sitting or standing pose works beautifully. Action shots and wide outdoor scenes can be engraved, but the closer the framing, the more detail comes through. If you have a phone photo of your pet that you already love, send it and we'll tell you what's possible. Photos with multiple pets work in Medium and larger sizes; for single-pet portraits, any size works. What's in the box Your pet crystal ships in a premium gift-ready box - a navy presentation box with the Beyond Memories wordmark in gold, a soft microfiber pouch for cleaning, and a printed care card. The crystal is nested in custom-cut foam to survive transit. If you add a Memory Light Base at checkout, it ships in the same box with its USB-C power cable. Crystal care K9 optical crystal is scratch-resistant and water-safe. Wipe with the included microfiber cloth - a quick buff removes fingerprints. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Dust occasionally with the same microfiber. Deeper cleaning with a drop of dish soap in warm water will not damage the engraving. The crystal suits any indoor surface - nightstand, desk, mantel, or a quiet corner where you remember them. Production and shipping Standard production is 1-2 business days from photo approval. Faster shipping options are available at checkout. Orders before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination - rates at checkout. Add a date note in Special Instructions and our team confirms timing before production. Frequently asked questions What pet photos work best? Close-up portraits in good natural light. Face, head-and-shoulders, or seated full-body framing all engrave well. Bright eye highlights and visible fur texture in the original translate beautifully into the crystal. Can I include more than one pet? Yes. Two pets fit comfortably from Medium and up. Three or more pets are sharpest in Large, XL, or Max sizes - each face needs enough engraving area to keep its detail. Can I add my pet's name and dates? Yes. Add the name, birth-and-rainbow dates, or a short message in the Special Instructions field at checkout - no extra charge. Is this a good pet memorial gift? Yes. The rectangle crystal is one of the most-ordered shapes for pet memorial keepsakes. The engraving never fades. Pair with the rosewood Memory Light Base for soft evening illumination. Standard vs 4K HD engraving? 4K HD adds finer fur detail, smoother gradients, sharper eye highlights - most noticeable on close-up viewing or with a light base. For a keepsake you'll keep forever, 4K HD is worth it. What if my photo isn't great? Send it anyway. Our design team enhances brightness, contrast, and clarity - if a photo truly isn't workable, we'll email you before production starts. We'd rather delay than engrave a photo that doesn't honor your pet.
